generic_statement: For arbitrary G and two commuting idempotent endomorphisms e,f, the actual pair map onto the subgroup of compatible fixed pairs is surjective, has kernel ker(e) intersect ker(f), and is an explicit multiplicative equivalence when that intersection is trivial.

semantic_checks.finding: The carrier specifies actual fixed points and equality f(x)=e(y), not an opaque assumed target. Coordinate multiplication and inversion preserve all conditions even before assuming idempotence.
Idempotence proves each coordinate fixed and commutation gives compatibility; the homomorphism uses actual e and f.

The literal preimage is x*(e(y))^-1*y in G. Idempotence and the fixed-point conditions give e of the preimage=x. Commutation with f(y)=y gives f(e(y))=e(y), so f of the preimage=y. No commutativity of G or finite generation is required.
The lift gives a witness for every actual compatible pair. Equality to the identity is exactly both component equalities, hence the intersection of the kernels.

The kernel intersection hypothesis supplies injectivity. The equivalence uses the literal pairMap forward and liftPair backward; the left inverse follows from injectivity and the proved right inverse.
The inverse formula is definitional equality, not a chosen or unverified abstract inverse.
